description.value: Little Umbrella is a neighbourhood café on West 10th Avenue in Vancouver with a mission of 'great coffee, honest food, real connection,' proudly serving beans from West End Coffee. The menu features a range of espresso drinks alongside house-crafted sandwiches and wraps, including a vegan option. Catering is available and orders can be placed for delivery or pickup.
